purpose: Non-confirmatory infrastructure and sign-stability preflight using fresh Person vectors before a separately registered confirmatory study of the known probabilistic assignment mechanism.

prior_evidence.role: The fixed-Person screening selected candidate diagnostics and supplied rough planning dispersion only. Its observations are not pooled with this preflight or any future confirmation.

data_generating_process.person_distribution: independent standard-normal draws, standardized separately within each vector to realized mean 0 and population SD 0.8
data_generating_process.common_random_numbers: Within each Person vector, all three gamma conditions select from the same complete Person-by-Rater-by-Task-by-Criterion response matrix. Assignment generation never reads potential or realized Score.

assignment.distribution: Pr(G | fixed Person degrees, fixed Rater degrees, connected) proportional to exp(gamma*T(G))
assignment.implementation: qualified vectorized dense-margin exact DP with connected rejection

estimation_layers.role: same-estimand external calibration; not a gold standard for MML or CMLE

estimation_layers.estimand: normal-person marginal likelihood with population SD fixed at 0.8
normal-person marginal likelihood with population SD estimated

primary_candidate.screening_derivation_timing: Defined after the fixed-Person screening but before every preflight Person and response draw.
primary_candidate.advancement_signal: mean greater than zero and at least 3 of 4 fresh Person-vector statistics greater than zero; this is a design-stability gate, not a hypothesis test

secondary_candidates.statistic: fixed-SD MML symmetric stress Rater RMSE contrast
secondary_candidates.advancement_signal: mean greater than zero and at least 3 of 4 values greater than zero
mean less than zero and at least 3 of 4 values less than zero

secondary_candidates.statistic: 0.5 * [OLS slope of Rater truth error on true severity at gamma=-0.8 minus the corresponding slope at gamma=+0.8]

descriptive_only: JMLE and exact-CMLE symmetric stress Rater RMSE contrasts
assignment correlation and statistic by Person vector and gamma
all failures, retries, constraints, and runtimes
preflight_diagnostics.inference_prohibition: Do not compute confirmatory p-values, declare replication, or pool n=4 with the earlier n=10 fixed-Person screening.

precision_contract.scientific_recovery: Use native-precision Python truth errors within each estimator lane.
precision_contract.facets_measure_threshold: Use the registered high-precision Umean=6 primary report for measures and thresholds.
precision_contract.facets_fit: Ordinary displayed FACETS fit fields are rounded evidence only and never raw inputs.
precision_contract.prohibition: Never reconstruct unreported raw fit or residual statistics from FACETS' usual two-decimal display.

advancement_rule: Only after all operational gates pass, inspect the four registered sign-stability diagnostics. Regardless of their outcome, retain the complete preflight and exclude all four vectors from confirmation. If PF1 fails its advancement signal, do not silently change direction or select a different estimator endpoint; redesign or stop. If PF1 passes, freeze a separate confirmatory plan and sample size before drawing any further Person vector.
claim_limit: This four-vector preflight can expose pipeline defects and gross Person-vector dependence. It cannot confirm an effect, estimate a real missingness mechanism, rank estimators, establish robustness, or justify a public product claim.
